checks.message: Provisional boundary is correctly labeled and disclosed; content scoring remains eligible.
All three provisional key areas are labeled and remain non-statutory.
Grid-clipped land-use polygons form a complete non-overlapping partition of the submitted boundary.
Known spatial metrics were recomputed in EPSG:4548 from submission geometry.
Twelve scenarios include three test beds, human review, data minimization and exit conditions.
Offline HTML contains no remote resources, forms, tracking or network calls.
Fifteen bilingual pairs of analytical figures were regenerated from the same geometry, metrics and proposal structure.
Three original AI-generated concept visualizations are explicitly labeled as non-photographic, non-site-exact design intent.
No external map tiles, screenshots, logos or proprietary marks are embedded; OSM vector context is attributed under ODbL and original AI concept visuals are disclosed.
Boundary, controls, existing conditions, governance and implementation gaps are explicit.
The revised proposal separates official facts, planning inferences and field-verification needs, and maps six diagnosed problems to goals, actions, projects and future metrics.
Latest taskbook: three positionings, five functions, Three Zones and Two Wings, official tasks and agent.1-agent.6 map to dedicated prose, figures and evidence.
Chinese and English proposal, report, exhibit, A3/A0 PDFs and all text-bearing figures are paired; the latest bilingual validator reports no issue.
Eleven infrastructure systems distinguish survey needs, conceptual actions, interfaces and operating KPIs; no unverified alignment or capacity is claimed.
Commercial hierarchy, users, operating models and reinvestment are defined without fabricated rent, revenue, payback or funding commitments.
OpenStreetMap context is attributed under ODbL and explicitly excluded from official boundary/control evidence.
